control.description-key: Replaces a view grid with a month calendar, placing each record in the view on the day matching a configurable date field.

property.name: dateFieldName
property.description-key: Logical name of the date field used to place each record on the calendar (default: itr_expectedstartdate).

property.name: titleFieldName
property.description-key: Logical name of the field used as the label on each calendar chip (default: itr_employeename).
